mapper.select: SELECT a.plan_id, a.instance_id, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(h.mete_name) AND ISNULL(f.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(g.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(h.mete_name) AND ISNULL(f.inspection_name) THEN g.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(h.mete_name) AND ISNULL(g.preset_name) THEN f.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(f.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(g.preset_name) THEN h.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(f.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(h.mete_name,'/',g.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(g.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(h.mete_name,'/',f.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name, b.device_id, d.device_name, b.custom_id, b.text_desc AS behavior, i.dict_note AS custom_name, b.cruise_type, e.dict_note AS cruise_type_name, a.point_type, a.area_id, a.cruise_region_ids, a.exception_type, a.robot_id, a.position, a.algorithm_id, a.inferad_analyze, a.ir_temp_box, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.sub_type, j.dict_note AS sub_type_name FROM t_cruise_plan_attr a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance b ON a.instance_id = b.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device d ON b.device_id = d.device_id AND b.custom_id = d.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e ON b.cruise_type = e.dict_code AND e.col_name = "cruise_type" LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection f ON f.inspection_id = b.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset g ON b.cruise_id = g.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete h ON h.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business i ON i.dict_code = b.custom_id AND i.col_name = "custom_type" LEFT JOIN t_dict_business j ON a.sub_type = j.dict_code AND j.col_name = "sub_plan_type" where 1 = 1 and a.plan_id = #{planId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY b.device_id, b.custom_id,a.instance_id
